title: Final Fight One

rows: Fast ninja, quick combos, wall jump
Slow but huge damage, piledriver throw
Street Fighter Alpha versions, unlocked by play records

widgets.text: A+B together = a desperation attack that costs a little health but clears enemies around you.

Damnd (Slum): jump-kick him when he whistles for help.
Sodom (Subway): pick up a weapon or throw him; avoid his sword dash.
Edi. E (West Side): the cop with a gun; stay off his line.
Rolento (Industrial): keep moving, his grenades land where you stood.
Abigail (Bay Area): huge damage; grab-throw when he finishes a punch.
Belger (Up Town): stay close, he shoots at range; hit him off the wheelchair and finish quickly.
widgets.title: Tips

rows: Throw it with attack (Cody stabs repeatedly)

widgets.text: Final Fight One keeps records for unlocking extras: clearing the game and meeting conditions unlocks the Alpha versions of Guy and Cody and alternate costume colours.
